The webpage may ask you to sign in and may be affected by your DNS settings.

JustWatch has no advertising or analytics SDKs and no developer-operated video server. Links are processed on your phone. Video platforms, Cloudflare DNS and GitHub receive requests and your IP address. App-update checks run at most daily when you open the app; update downloads require your action and APK installation requires Android approval. Temporary videos are deleted on a best-effort basis. Settings, diagnostics and engine files stay locally until removed. The optional webpage viewer may retain cookies and website data. Clear app storage to remove local data. Contact Amine-AO through GitHub; issues are public, so do not post personal information.
This is a summary. The full privacy policy is currently available in English.
